data.narrative:
Fabri operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector populated by one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The target's stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, limiting precision in peer selection.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The analysis identified eleven same-sector robotics peers but zero companies meeting simultaneous filters for stage alignment, adjacent-stage proximity, or similar valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the heterogeneity within robotics valuations across stage and business model. Consequently, no quantitative triangulation result is supported by the available data. The narrow peer set and lack of stage-specific comparables prevent reliable multiples-based benchmarking.

A defensible valuation of Fabri cannot be anchored to this dataset. Proceed by: (1) clarifying the company's development stage and disclosed funding history to refine peer filtration; (2) conducting primary diligence on the five named private peers to establish valuation benchmarks at matching stages; (3) stress-testing against the single public comparable where applicable, acknowledging its likely limited relevance. Without stage clarity and a minimum of three validated peers, any range offered would lack analytical foundation.
